contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: We are here to help you
contact.aboutText1: We are specialists in rare coins and numismatics. We offer a carefully curated selection of antique, rare, and collectible coins, both Argentine and international.
contact.aboutText2: Every piece in our catalog is authentic and has been carefully selected for discerning collectors.
contact.faqQ1: How can I make a purchase?
contact.faqA1: Contact us by email or WhatsApp indicating the coin of your interest. We will respond with availability and payment methods.
contact.faqA2: Yes, we ship throughout the country. Shipping costs are calculated according to destination and package weight.
contact.faqA3: Absolutely. All our coins are authentic and each piece can be verified.

footer.about: Specialists in rare coins and numismatics. We offer a curated selection of authentic coins for collectors.
